content: {"days": [{"day": 1, "title": "Kanchendzonga Views & Waterfalls", "narrative": "Begin with panoramic Kanchendzonga views from the skywalk, then visit Khecheopalri Lake Viewpoint, the historic Coronation Stone, and conclude at Kunchenjunga Waterfall."}, {"day": 2, "title": "Yuksom & Tikjuk Viewpoint", "narrative": "Explore the offbeat charm of Yuksom and the serene Tikjuk Viewpoint, immersed in nature and cultural surroundings."}, {"day": 3, "title": "Tiger Hill & Darjeeling Heritage", "narrative": "Witness the sunrise at Tiger Hill, then tour Tenzing Rock, the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Mall Road, and the Tomb of Tenzing Norgay."}]}
